season.text: GSW won by 51 on 11/9: the first loss by 50 or more for the Pelicans in franchise history
Trae Young (WAS) made 17 free throws on 11/12: the first game with 15+ free throws for the Wizards since Bradley Beal (18 FTM, 2/23/20)
WAS scored 140 on 11/12: the first 140-point game for the Wizards since 11/28/22 (142-127, MIN)
GSW won by 51 on 11/9: the first win by 50 or more by the Warriors since 4/9/23 (157-101, POR)
